review_type: static read-only pre-execution source sealing and P7 order review

findings.issue: The snapshot gate checks only top-level audit passed/reproduction_verified, not the actual R0030 run entry or committed/pushed audit and manifest bytes.
findings.false_positive_case: A completed but uncommitted R0030 manifest and an incorrectly named or stale successful reproduction audit can pass while HEAD and remote match; committed index/journal alone do not attest the R0030 archive/audit bytes.
findings.minimal_fix: Require runs entry run_id R0030, integrity_passed=true, eligible_completed=true, reproduction_verification.verified=true, formal_run_id R0028, and compare working manifest/audit bytes with HEAD Git blobs; retain their path/hash/source commit in mapping. Do not read models or raw.
findings.resolution: Six gate files must match pushed HEAD Git bytes, including actual R0030 manifest/reproduction receipt/audit; require exactly one audit.runs R0030 entry with integrity_passed, eligible_completed and reproduction_verification.verified, plus top-level audit passed/reproduction_verified and completed manifest.

findings.issue: The script checks current freeze.source_files only, not the current freeze file identity against original final/reproduction config SHA.
findings.false_positive_case: A changed config/protocol/selection field in current F0001 JSON can leave every listed source-file pin intact. Source-pin verification is not freeze-payload identity verification.
findings.minimal_fix: Hash model_selection.json bytes, require equality with both configs/p6_final.json and configs/p7_reproduce_final.json freeze SHA and expected F0001 identity; optionally verify canonical payload; include this receipt in snapshot mapping.
findings.resolution: The original F0001 byte SHA is hard-pinned to 286c7de3cc56da3c6c61e16670bde538a672de7bca7f4b3136ce68501c2648f4; both formal/reproduction config SHA fields must match it, then all science source pins are checked. Mapping includes gate file receipts.

confirmations.check: Python syntax parses without executing module
Remote and local HEAD equality gate exists
confirmations.scope: Current remote head is queried by the helper only when eventually executed; this review did not run it or query remote.

confirmations.check: Builder source and config committed byte checks
Original index/journal Git bytes checked and snapshot written without overwrite
confirmations.details: out.mkdir(exist_ok=False); copied original path subtree; target readback exact equality; mapping includes original_path,snapshot_path,bytes,sha256,source_git_commit.

details.report_output_rows: source_receipts.json.outputs path is relative to reports/research_v01, not project root

confirmations.details: Both builders still read live original index/journal. The snapshot is independent preserved evidence, not a builder input. Post-build comparison against snapshot is required before appending logs.
audit_delivery rejects index/journal and any path under current run output. README/progress exclusion is a delivery-list policy; code does not automatically exclude them.

run_pipeline pins pre-run committed public 00 as a historical source. audit_delivery renders public/archive 00, then hashes public 00 in delivery_receipts; run manifest later hashes its own archive. This has no hash cycle.

verify_research_archive sets top-level reproduction_verified from per-run reproduction_verification.verified. Formal final flags remain separate. Saved verifier declares no refit/raw reads and does not replace archived full refit.

required_order: Wait for existing batch R0030 full refit, independent audit and push; do not start another pipeline.
Commit and push all valid run evidence and final builder/config changes; verify HEAD/remote and actual R0030 audit identity.
Validate original F0001 identity/source pins and original index/journal Git bytes; create new S0001 and immutable mapping.
Build final report and presentation content in one no-index/journal-write window.
Verify both input source receipt arrays map original index/journal paths to exactly S0001 bytes/hash and source commit; preserve a separate consumption check receipt.
Generate real PDF/editable PPTX/600-second silent captioned video, actual QA and canonical copies; finalize instructions and explicit per-file delivery_paths.
Commit P7 source/config/public pre-run 00; run new R0031 only after all required files exist. Exclude mutable status pages/live bookkeeping/current R0031/self/postaudit unknown outputs.

P7 renders 00 then seals public 00; afterward do final links/visual QA and whole archive audit outside completed run, commit final status/supplemental receipts and push without mutating sealed artifacts.
limitations: R0030 is running; no completed R0030 audit or final report/content exists yet. Snapshot helper was not executed.
No raw data, prediction rows, pickle/joblib, large model files or new pipeline run was read/executed.
This is static code/schema/order review, not successful final source sealing, not full scientific revalidation and not P7 pass.
Post-builder source receipt to snapshot verification is procedural and is not implemented by this snapshot helper.
mapping.scope currently says exact bytes consumed before either build has run; treat that as intended scope and write a separate actual consumption-verification receipt afterward.

The helper lives in ignored tmp/. If exact sealing procedure retention is desired, preserve its reviewed bytes or SHA outside tmp; mapping and exact snapshot bytes remain sufficient for data-byte comparison.
Actual external rendering runtime versions/fonts/tool hashes and PDF/PPTX/video/Notebook visual QA can only be certified after generating their real receipts and reviewing outputs.
Post-P7 final 00 QA and post-audit outputs cannot be retroactively inserted into the sealed current-run delivery list; preserve as separately committed supplementary receipts.
